method: Reviewed every scoped candidate body/context block and every unused block against frozen exam-only text and independent gold.
Rendered and visually inspected original PDF pages1–2 for both papers.
Checked joined stored block text equals frozen exam-only input for both papers and all third-source question block ids equal corresponding candidate ids.
block_id_convention: 0-based stored block array; frozen source lines are 1-based (block+1 here).
caveats: Scores are boundary/content preservation relative to the supplied text, NOT exact mathematical or diagram fidelity to PDF.
Fourth organization failed deadline per task: no fourth topic/root semantic score, no inference from the extracted bank having zero persisted fourth questions.
Third B4 split is ambiguous, not an actual question omission/spurious-question finding.
Third I.9 context contains I.10 stem from a fused text block; distinguish upstream mixing from the extractor selecting the mixed block as context.
